title: rupturegrid-scenario/v1
description: RuptureGrid v1.1 scenario document (Phase 17, ADR-0019): pure data binding the accepted experiment vocabulary to a stable target selector, with optional acceptance EXPECTATIONS that never influence evaluation or exit classification.

target.description: Stable, portable target selector. displayName is a USER-FACING lookup convenience ONLY (registration makes it unique) — NEVER a security principal. The resolved registration (id, origins, environment, manifest, credential refs, platform authorization) remains authoritative; no scenario field grants target authority.

steps.description: The EXISTING accepted ExperimentDocument step vocabulary (validated authoritatively by @rupturegrid/engine). Not re-described here.

invariantBindings.description: Optional business-invariant/v1 instances (ADR-0018/ADR-0023 §6 exact schemas). Validated authoritatively against the target manifest evidence policy by @rupturegrid/engine.

runScope.description: Optional run-scope/v1 anchor intent (ADR-0026 §3 closed declaration). Validated authoritatively against the frozen steps, generic bindings, and evidence policy by @rupturegrid/engine; frozen into target.runScopeBinding and covered by snapshotContentHash.

expectations.description: Acceptance expectations for committed regression assertions (Phase 18 consumption). They NEVER influence evaluation, findings, report truth, or exit classification — durable truth alone decides.
